info.title: Opera Agent Gateway
info.description: One-hop browser control for any AI platform. Authenticate with body.apiKey (GPT Actions) or the x-opera-agent-token header.

post.summary: Run one browser action and wait for its result

200.description: Command result: ok true on success, or ok false with a structured error the caller can act on (e.g. stale element, element not found).

504.description: Device did not report back within waitMs; the action may still have succeeded — verify page state before repeating.
